hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad hook for ERC-20 tokens on Uniswap v4. Manages token pools through a bonding curve phase, automatically graduating to a standard AMM pool when the bonding curve supply is exhausted. Takes a 5% swap fee (1% creator, 1% platform, 3% protocol) via afterSwapReturnsDelta. External liquidity additions, removals, and pool initializations are blocked to this hook only.
